Structure is not the meaning of “logos.”

Schleiden is known for cell theory, not for studying the dark reactions of photosynthesis.
Melvin Calvin studied the dark reactions, which are also called the Calvin cycle.

1965 is not the year of the discovery of the cell.

Connective tissue supports and binds other tissues rather than forming glands.
